name: Magic Arrow Amazon (Ezo leveling guide)
description: Magic Arrow Amazon from Ezo's S13 starter guide: Normal, Nightmare, Hell and early maps, one stage each with that stage's gear, stats, skill order and notes. Source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UbReGCNhqeYQIgYA8ihOyGuGJ1u_lBafCK7IX9wzHIs

stages.title: Nightmare
stages.note: 1 point in every remaining passive. Start pushing Dexterity (the Matriarchal Bow later needs 187). Max the Magic Arrow synergies (Inner Sight, Slow Movement, Guided Arrow) and Valkyrie; the order is up to you, Valkyrie gets very useful late NM to Hell. Runewords: Lore (Ort Sol), Peace (Shael Thul Amn), Purity (Amn Eth Thul) for the merc. Hsarus belt + boots (or Raven Frost) fix AR. Skystrike is great late Normal to NM if it drops. NM Cows are a good farm.

stages.title: Hell (cheap gear)
stages.note: Melody (Shael Ko Nef) in a 3-socket Stag, Ashwood or Matriarchal Bow with +2/+3 Bow skills; any +5/+6 Melody is a huge upgrade, so buy a base if needed. Hustle (Shael Ko Eld) for the chest. Shop +3 Bow gloves (20 IAS best) from Anya/Charsi at Lvl 65+; gamble or Blood craft a +Bow/Amazon amulet. 86 IAS for 7 frames with Hustle: keep 1 Large Charm with 6%+ IAS. Get half freeze duration somewhere unless you use Raven Frost. Farm Terror Zones, Chaos, Cows, Travincal.

stages.title: Early Maps (mid gear)
stages.note: 168 IAS for 7 frames with Hustle. IAS is flexible: 1 more Shael in Ebonbane can replace 20 IAS on the gloves, and Goldwrap (20%) can stand in if you lack IAS, at the cost of Verdungo's tankiness. Bow skillers matter most; get Torch and Anni last. Merc: Lava Gout for the Enchant Fire buff, Marrowwalk for freeze immunity. If you want to go into Fire/Cold Arrow, don't improve the gear any further.

stages.title: S14 Endgame
stages.note: With the addition of 5% Magic Damage Jewels this Build gets a significant Damage Buff. To accomodate as many jewels as possible we need Faith RW on our Merc to still cap attack speed without Shaels or Hustle. Best Body Armor to replace Hustle would be a 4os Blood Crafted Rare with Pdr, 3os Silks of the Victor, Skullder or Arkaines would work aswell. One of the 5% magic damage jewels also needs 15 ias.

build.title: Early (Normal)
build.stageNote: Stats: first 3 levels in Energy, 1 level in Strength, the rest in Vitality or whatever gear needs. Skills: 1 point in Evade asap, everything else in Magic Arrow. Gamble a belt from Gheed (3 potion rows) and look for Mana after Kill (rings, Tir in helm). A1 Vigor merc for run speed, or Meditation if mana is tight. Optional: Stealth (Tal Eth) and Zephyr (Ort Eth) from Countess. Shop a Teleport-charge staff from Ormus (A3) for swap, ideally below lvl 24.

name: Mind Blast Assassin S14 - Season Starter
description:
This is the ultimate early-season ladder starter for the Mind Blast Assassin. It relies on trading for the core pieces early, making it ideal for trade leagues rather than SSF or Single Player. 

Acquiring the 3-piece Naj's set provides unmatched early mobility with Blink, drastically speeding up your farm rate.

Prioritizing Naj's set gives you a solid foundation to quickly run Chaos Sanctuary and LOD content. Once you stack your inventory with Skillers, an Anni, and a Torch, you can seamlessly transition into T1 and T2 mapping without expensive end-game gear.

Core Naj's Set Bonus (3-Piece)
+6 All Skills
+75 All Resistances
90% FCR
3 Blink charges (1 charge restored every 3 seconds)

Key Gear & Stat Breakpoints

Core Gear: 3-piece Naj's, +2 Shadow Dancers, +3 Magic Amulet, and Raven Frost.

102% FCR Breakpoint: Easy to hit by getting 12% FCR combined across your belt and second ring slot.

Resistances: Near-capped using Fade, charms, and res rolls on your belt and FCR ring.

Sockets & Utility: Use Larzuk's Malus to socket your helm/armor with Perfect Topazes for MF (save your socket quests!), and place a Tir rune in your staff for +2 MAEK sustain.

Progression Milestone: Farm LOD content like Chaos Sanctuary until your Mind Blast damage exceeds 7k via inventory skillers. At that threshold, you can jump into T1 maps comfortably and efficiently.

name: Mind Blast Assassin S14 - Mapping Setup
description:
S14 Mind Blast Mapper – Summary

Core S14 Updates
- Swap claws to 1× Shadow Killer + 1× Whispering Mirage (no longer dual Mirage).
- Hit 174 FCR and 50 IAS breakpoints for 9‑frame casting and 8‑frame Dragonflight.
- A1 Physical Merc + Wrath is now clearly best‑in‑slot; reliable Amp proc is more valuable after recent Mirage phys‑pierce nerfs.
- Dragonflight is now the primary mobility/engage tool—faster animation than Blink and procs Amp more consistently. Use Blink only when Dragonflight can’t target (off‑screen packs).

Why 1 Shadow Killer + 1 Mirage (instead of dual Mirage)

Pros
- Faster Dragonflight: Shadow Killer’s IAS breakpoint makes DF 2–3 frames quicker, improving mapping speeds.
- Reliable Frost Nova procs: Blade Shield + Shadow Killer gives consistent FN on engage, improving safety and letting you Mind Blast immediately without interruption.
- Better mana sustain: Shadow Killer provides up to 8 MAEK, removing the need for expensive dual MAEK/LAEK jewels. ~6 MAEK is enough for pot‑free solo mapping.
- More damage + easier gearing:
Shadow Killer has 4 skills + 25 base FCR vs Mirage’s 2 skills + 10 FCR.
- Lets you run +1 skill corruption instead of needing dual 20 FCR corruptions to hit 174 FCR.
- The extra 2 base skills generally outperform the lost –5 phys pierce, especially with Amp active.

Cons
- Less Phys Pierce (-5 instead of -10), so Amplify Damage proc from your Merc is more important to build around for end game T3 Mapping.
- Dual Mirage provided 3 Shadow Warriors instead of 2, slightly reducing damage on small packs and stragglers.  It also reduced single target damage slightly for map bosses.

name: Equa1ity's standard fireclaw (mapping)
description:
- Standard Fireclaw build: ~7k Fire / 22k Physical damage.
- Versatile Can run many different maps, tanky, and capable of Ubers and DClone (not T2 anymore).
- **Don't trust sheet damage.** Actual fire damage is higher than displayed.

**when buying hellslayer**: Purchase 35 ias slammed hellslayer not 34,  36 -40 is fine but dont pay extra for a 40 if you dont have to.
**Mercenary Options**
- **A5 Fanaticism:** More life and 1 faster attack frame.
- **A1 Fanaticism:** 1 faster attack frame, Might (Templar's), and Vigor.
- **A1 Mist (Preferred):** 100% Uninterruptible Attack feels amazing and improves clear speed more than another attack frame, in my experience. and you still get might
- **A4 Dark + Infinity:** Amp Damage and reduced enemy Fire Resistance. With 65% fire pierce already, I'm not convinced Infinity justifies the cost. Never felt particularly fast.

**Weapon & Shield**
- **Ghostflame + Phoenix:** Higher sheet damage, but you lose a ton of phys, better for bossing or pvp
- **Hellslayer (Preferred):** Flat fire damage and massive physical hits make mapping noticeably faster than Ghostflame + Phoenix.

**Gloves**
- **Hellmouth:** +150 flat fire damage and -10% enemy Fire Resistance. (better early)
- **Magefist:** +1 Fire Skills. (wins once fully geared with Rainbow Facets)

**Amulet**
- Mara's early
-  +2 Druid Hit Power Amulet (Preferred)
- Rising Sun kinda sucks dont do it it's a trap

Griffions isn't worth the loss of resistances and hfd. Damage is easier to get elsewhere.

Another option is Cerebus bite if you can get very good res on armor or give up amulet for Maras. 

In both seasons i had pretty decent armor but only 3 sockets. Armor on this build is max roll example what to aim for. minimal 3 sockets 150% ed and 20% pdr.

Viperfork is there to draw attention as a viable option. I started out with it from day one. Its very nice on ear cow maps. Otherwise i used standard cta lidless.

Notice my choice is Gore rider. Deadly strike is crucial cause there is very little room to get it going outside Cerebus option i mentioned. You are free to experiment with phasing Inferno stride booties.

name: Vengeance
description:
Vengeance without using full chain chance and pcombs. Going full flat dmg scs with life. More damage and chain chance doesn't feel significantly different/different at all in my opinion. we have 78% chance to chain still, and the SCs give you much more flexibility in res and life stacking.

PDR from Dragonscale, flat fire, and max fire res have much more coverage offensively and defensively than HoZ. Azurewrath, Merman's, and Raven give you disproportionately more cold elemental added dmg than any others so we go all in on that with some fire facet split to gain some extra coverage. 

The IAS from Azurewrath makes it much easier to hit the IAS BP with Highlords + crafted belt. Belt slot is variable, but slam dependent on gettting and IAS hit which is expensive.

We gain so much pierce from Convic that I would worry more about getting +% on facets than -. Pierce has diminishing returns on non-immune monsters which are going to be a majority of our kills, so look for +5/-3 as they're actually better options than 5/5 (and cheaper). 

Dracs can be swapped with Hellmouth for more DPS, but LAEK and Strength to give us more vit is better QoL imo. 

Arkaine's Valor is the only armor for this build imo. The others dont offer the +2 skill/high end FHR/high reduced flat phys/and massive life pool all in one armor. 

Build works for high end group mapping as main DPS/support with solid convic level, T0 Dclone and Lucion are very easy on this with minor gear swaps. (Lightsabre for Lucion and Lava Gout for max fire res for Dclone).

I've mained this build the last 2 seasons I've done T2 Lucion on this character but no other T2s are recommended as the life pool isn't high enough for Dclone as you want to be ~3k.ns on HC hitting 99 in S12 and 3rd T2 Lucion Kill in S13. Viable for both SC + HC.

Dumping remaining points into Joust or Holy Shock is up to you. We do enough damage that the QoL of Joust is my preference. Charge is rotated as the main mobility vehicle as well.
